name: Generalist
description: A smidge of everything -- code, debugging, writing, research, and light data/findings analysis. None of them deeply specialized, unlike the presets below. Good default if you're not sure which specialized preset fits yet, or just want a team broad enough to get started.

name: Coding
description: Python, frontend (HTML/CSS/JS/TS), everything-else language work, debug/QA, and research.

name: Content/Writing
description: Draft, edit, and fact-check articles, posts, or copy.

name: Research/Analysis
description: Dig into a topic, structure the findings, and produce a written report.

name: DevOps/Infrastructure
description: Infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and production incident response.
